page: UpCloud GPU-48xCPU-960GB-4xH100 is a GPU-accelerated server configured with 48 vCPUs and 960 GB of system memory. The processing power is delivered by an Intel Xeon 8462Y+ processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, operating at 2.0 GHz with 48 physical cores and a single thread per core allocation. The system features four NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs, providing a total of 320 GB of VRAM. No local storage is bundled with this instance type, and virtualization is managed via KVM.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core and memory performance. The server achieved a Passmark CPU score of 85,426.66 and a stress-ng multi-core CPU performance score of 96,293.69, placing it in the top tier and strong categories respectively. Memory bandwidth for small cached blocks reached a top-tier speed of 7,649.82 GB/sec, while large-block uncached read bandwidth was measured at 316.04 GB/sec. For specialized workloads, the system demonstrated high efficiency in single-threaded gzip compression at 35.37 GB/sec and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 615.79 GB/sec. LLM inference benchmarks using a small 135M model yielded 10,308.98 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 377.14 tokens/sec for text generation.

Given the high-density hardware profile combining 960 GB of RAM with four enterprise-grade H100 GPUs, this server represents a specialized resource tier. The absence of local storage means storage requirements must be handled externally, which is a key architectural tradeoff. This configuration is optimized for memory-intensive and GPU-bound workloads, such as large-scale machine learning, LLM training and inference, complex data science jobs, and high-performance computing simulations.
